title: Ceregrow Grain Selection Ragi, Mixed Fruit & Ghee Cereal

details.description: Discover the delightful Ceregrow Grain Selection, a toddler cereal that blends the goodness of traditional Indian ingredients with modern nutritional benefits. Inspired by beloved millet recipes, this cereal features the ancient grain of Ragi, also known as finger millet, which has been cultivated in India for over 4,000 years. Enriched with over 14 essential vitamins and minerals, including immune-boosting Vitamin A, C, D, iron, and zinc, this cereal supports your little one's normal immune system function. Crafted with care, the Ceregrow Grain Selection offers a nutritious and flavourful bowl of Ragi, mixed fruit, and ghee, ensuring a tasty and wholesome experience for your growing child. With no added flavours or colours, this cereal from the trusted Nestle brand delivers quality you can count on, making it the perfect choice to nourish and delight your little one.
details.storageInstructions:
Store unopened pack in a cool, dry place.
After opening, store the prepared product within the pack tightly closed container to avoid microbial deterioration.
1. Boil drinking water for 5 minutes and leave it till lukewarm.
2. Pour 130ml of lukewarm water into a bowl. Add 50g powder (6 level scoops) of ceregrow.
3. Mix the powder well with water. A nutritious bowl of ceregrow is now ready.

Usage: Mix 2 tsp (15g) Nestea powder in a glass (150 ml) of cold water.

One glass of Nestea is ready to serve.
